role: The single source of truth for how every image in this project looks. The print desk compiles a prompt from it (src/look/compile.mjs) and feeds that prompt + the reference photo to FLUX.2 [klein] 4B. Nothing visual ships that was not drawn from this file.

city.name: Bahía Rosa
city.note: Invented coastal city. Never name, depict, or imply a real game location, studio, or franchise.

compliance.note: The challenge requires original visuals only: no third-party assets, no leaked material, no trademarks. These rules are enforced in code, not just intent — see assertSafe() in src/look/compile.mjs.
compliance.promptTail: Original fan-made artwork, invented city and characters, no third-party characters, no franchise marks, no logos, no interface overlays, no text of any kind, no watermark, no signature. Not affiliated with any game studio or publisher.
compliance.disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made project for the Unlayer Build with React Image Editor Challenge. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

identity.note: The person must survive the restyle. A plate that loses the face is a failed plate, no matter how pretty.
rules: Keep the subject's face clearly recognisable: same face shape, same jawline, same brow, same nose and mouth proportions.
Keep hair length, hairline, and hair texture as photographed, including how it falls.
Keep glasses if worn, including frame shape and lens thickness.
Keep skin tone and any visible marks — moles, freckles, stubble, scars.
Keep the natural expression and the angle of the head; do not straighten the pose.
One person only; no extra figures, no hands, no duplicated features.
forbidden: beautify the subject into a different person
change apparent age, ethnicity, or gender presentation
add jewellery, tattoos, or makeup that is not in the photo

registers.note: A register is the medium the plate is rendered in. Surfaces pick a register; the register picks a default lighting and palette.

character-shot.label: Character shot
character-shot.use: The default conversion: your photo restyled as a current-generation open-world character portrait standing in the city.
character-shot.medium: Photoreal character portrait rendered in a current-generation open-world engine: physically based materials, ray-traced global illumination with colour bouncing into shadow, believable skin lit with subsurface scattering at the ears, nose and cheekbones, hair resolved strand by strand with light passing through the tips, visible pores and fine stubble.
character-shot.background: The invented coastal city behind the subject, softly out of focus but legible: palm fronds catching the light, pastel Art Deco facades, plate glass and chrome down a receding boulevard, a hazy skyline running past the edge of the frame.
character-shot.finish: Shot on an 85mm lens at f/1.8: the subject sharp, the city dissolved into creamy bokeh, clean highlight rolloff, subtle in-camera grain, no interface overlays, no on-screen readouts.

key-art.label: Key art
key-art.use: Loading screen. The illustrated portrait the city opens with.
key-art.medium: Hand-painted cel-shaded character key art for a high-fidelity open-world crime drama: confident bold ink linework, flat blocked colour areas with a single hard shadow tone, simplified modelling of form, warm graphic skin, minimal rendering, poster-grade composition.
key-art.background: Completely flat solid deep-maroon field with a few thin white line-art landmarks drawn behind the subject at low opacity; the field is clean, untextured, and evenly lit.
key-art.finish: Crisp vector-like edges, no photographic grain, no bloom, no lens artefacts.

press-photo.label: Press photo
press-photo.use: Front page. The photoreal editorial shot the tabloid runs.
press-photo.medium: Photoreal in-engine-style photograph from a current-generation open-world title: physically based materials, ray-traced global illumination with colour bleeding into shadow, wet-surface reflections, believable skin with subsurface scattering at ears, nose, and cheekbones.
press-photo.background: The invented coastal city at street level: sun-bleached stucco, faded signage, palm shadow, tropical humidity in the air.
press-photo.finish: Shot on a 50mm lens at f/2.0, shallow depth of field focused on the eyes, clean highlight rolloff, subtle in-camera film grain, no interface overlays, no on-screen readouts.

neon-night.label: Neon night
neon-night.medium: Photoreal night photograph of the invented city: saturated LED signage, streetlight bloom with visible light cones, a soft dome of city glow on the horizon, standing water on tarmac doubling every light source.
neon-night.background: Wet asphalt, brushed steel, plate glass, chrome trim, palm silhouettes reading as dark cut-outs.
neon-night.finish: Shot on a 35mm lens at f/1.8, wet-night reflections, deep blacks that keep detail, controlled magenta-and-cyan highlights, fine grain.

lighting.dual-rim: Two rim lights frame the subject whatever the hour: a warm amber light from one side, a strong magenta light from the other, both catching the hair and the edge of the cheek and jaw, while the face itself stays softly lit and fully legible. This two-tone rim light is the signature of the city's character portraits.
lighting.studio-flat: Even, soft, directionless studio light on the subject; no visible light source; no cast shadow on the field.
lighting.golden-hour-coastal: Late-afternoon subtropical sun at a low angle: warm amber key light, long soft shadows, humidity haze in the air, gentle bounce from pale walls.
lighting.midday-haze: High sun through humidity: slightly blown highlights on white surfaces, washed-out colour, heat shimmer on distant edges, hard short shadows.
lighting.overcast-blue-grey: Flat blue-grey overcast daylight: no direct sun, soft shadows, muted saturation, a cool cast that reads as real weather rather than a filter.
lighting.dusk-neon: Dusk into night: magenta and cyan signage as the dominant sources, warm interior spill from doorways, cool ambient sky overhead, strong specular highlights on wet ground.
lighting.interior-neon-club: Low-key interior: hard coloured practicals, smoke in the air, deep unlit background, faces lit by a nearby coloured source.

deco-pastel.description: Tropical Art Deco pastels: soft pink, sky blue, pale lemon, lavender, off-white stucco.

bleached-day.description: Sun-bleached coastal daylight: chalky white walls, pale turquoise water, warm sand, faded teal signage.

neon-wet.description: The city's signature grade: pink-and-teal sunset running into hot magenta signage, electric cyan, amber sodium accents, deep blue-black shadow, chrome highlights.

warm-dusk.description: Amber dusk: burnt orange sky, dusty rose clouds, violet shadow, warm rim light.

camera.framing: Head and shoulders, subject centred, eyes on the upper third, a little headroom, shoulders filling the lower edge.
camera.lens: 85mm equivalent for character portraits, 50mm for editorial shots, 35mm for street scenes; never a wide-angle distortion of the face.
camera.focus: Eyes tack sharp; the background falls away softly but stays readable.
camera.rimLight: Keep both rim lights legible where they touch the subject — hair edge, jawline, shoulder — without blowing them out.
camera.post: Restrained: no vignette, no tilt-shift, no HDR halos, no aggressive sharpening.

world.note: Original vocabulary only. These are shapes and textures, never named products, brands, or franchise locations.

render.seedPolicy: random by default; every produced plate records its seed and spec version in the filename and manifest
render.identityStrength: preserve the reference photo's subject; do not invent a new face
render.guidanceNote: klein is a distilled 4-step model: it runs at guidance 1.0 (no classifier-free guidance). Raising this does not add detail — it burns the image and wrecks the lighting. Cloudflare's own copy of this model and ComfyUI's official template both run cfg 1.
render.resolutionNote: klein 4B is happiest at 1K; keep input reference images under 512px per side as the model requires.

debut.brief: the character shot the city opens with: the subject standing in the city, lit by its signature two-tone rim light

loading.brief: clean grade, subject centred, name plate clear

frontpage.brief: face above the fold, masthead clear, tabloid drama

poster.brief: sell the room; the subject as the night's draw
